nodes.text: Taking Off Again with Kai Tak 與啟德再度啟航

The story of Cathay bringing people together and bridging the world began at Kai Tak. Just as Kai Tak transformed from an airport to Hong Kong’s new integrated sports and entertainment hub, we have since evolved from an airline to a premium travel lifestyle brand — all in pursuit of elevated experiences and journeys that connect our home city to the world. As the exclusive Founding Travel Partner of @kaitaksportsparkhk we are ready for more powerful, trailblazing moments in our city — we are ready to take off again. The story between Kai Tak and us continues. #Cathay #MoveBeyond #KTSP #KaiTakSportsPark 我們與世界連接、將人們匯聚的飛躍故事，從啟德開始。 啟德從機場蛻變成香港最大型綜合體育及休閒娛樂新地標，我們亦從一家航空公司，飛躍成為尊尚旅遊生活品牌——繼續連繫世界，致力為你躍升每個獨特體驗。 作為 #啟德體育園 的獨家創始旅遊合作夥伴，我們將攜手迎接更多盛大的歷史時刻，準備再度啟航，延續我們與啟德的故事。 #國泰 #志在飛躍
THE JOURNEY FROM HONG KONG TO THE WORLD
NOW THE JOURNEY COMES FULL CIRCLE
CATHAY 創始合作夥伴 Founding Partner
GOING BACK TO WHERE IT ALL STARTED
TAKING OFF AGAIN WITH KAI TAK
